Shadow the Scene · Reto 6 · Steve Carell

Reto Linking sounds

Cómo hacerlo

Escoge 6 de las 17 oraciones de la escena y graba un video de máximo 2 minutos donde se vea tu cara y tu boca leyéndolas. Antes de grabar, practica con los audios: toca Normal y Lento, escucha y repite en voz alta hasta que te sientas cómodo.

Postea tu video en el feed de la comunidad con el hashtag #ChallengeLinkingSounds
¿No sabes cómo? Mira aquí el video donde te explico paso a paso ▶

💬 Al publicar tu video en la comunidad, vas a recibir feedback para seguir mejorando.

Qué grabar

  1. Escoge 6 oraciones de la lista.
  2. Lee cada una 1 vez, imitando el ritmo y la entonación de la escena.

Las oraciones

  • OraciónEscuchar
  • 1First time I ever came to London, uh, was in 1984.
  • 2I got off the plane with a buddy of mine
  • 3and we had no idea where to go, what our schedule could be.
  • 4We had no transportation.
  • 5And a guy out of nowhere came up to us and said,
  • 6“Would you like a ride into London?” And
  • 7we hitched a ride with this guy.
  • 8He had just dropped off a friend.
  • 9We got in his car. He drove us into London.
  • 10“Hey, would you like a tour of London?” “Absolutely.”
  • 11He took us on an immediate tour of London.
  • 12“Want to go to lunch? I know a great place.”
  • 13We had a delicious lunch.
  • 14“Hey, you need a place to stay?
  • 15I know a great little bed and breakfast.”
  • 16He was the nicest guy in the world,
  • 17and he didn’t murder us at the end of it.
